assertion_results.text: Sibling check correctly classifies TC-8001 as a different-stream companion (stream [rhtpa-2.2] vs current issue's [rhtpa-2.1]), not a same-stream duplicate (Step 4)
assertion_results.evidence: sibling-check.md lines 18-21: 'TC-8006 stream suffix: [rhtpa-2.1] (stream 2.1.x) / TC-8001 stream suffix: [rhtpa-2.2] (stream 2.2.x) / Classification: **Different-stream sibling** (companion tracker)'. Line 22 confirms: 'No same-stream duplicates found. Proceeding to Step 4.2.' TC-8001 is explicitly classified as a different-stream companion, not a same-stream duplicate.

assertion_results.text: Step 4.2 checks the current issue's existing issuelinks before attempting to create a 'Related' link to TC-8001 (§1.58)
assertion_results.evidence: sibling-check.md lines 29-31: 'Per Step 4.2 procedure: before creating a link, check the current issue’s issuelinks array (already fetched in Step 1) for an existing link where: type.name is "Related", AND inwardIssue.key or outwardIssue.key matches the sibling key (TC-8001)'. triage-outcome.md lines 12-15 reconfirms: 'The Step 4.2 procedure requires checking for an existing link **before** creating one. assertion_results.text: Step 4.2 detects the pre-existing 'Related' link to TC-8001 and skips link creation — does NOT call jira.create_link (§1.58)
assertion_results.evidence: sibling-check.md line 39: 'Result: A matching Related link to TC-8001 already exists.' Lines 41-44: 'Action: **Skip link creation.** ... No jira.create_link call is made. The pre-existing link satisfies the cross-stream coordination requirement.' triage-outcome.md lines 35-40 corroborates: 'Link creation skipped. ... No jira.create_link call was made. This is the correct idempotent behavior defined in Step 4.2'.

assertion_results.text: The output includes a log message indicating the link was skipped because it already exists (e.g., 'Related link to TC-8001 already exists — skipping')
assertion_results.evidence: sibling-check.md line 42 contains the log message: '"Related link to TC-8001 already exists -- skipping"'. triage-outcome.md line 36 repeats the same log: '"Related link to TC-8001 already exists -- skipping"'. The message conveys the same meaning as the example in the assertion (using '--' instead of an em dash).
